title: The Healing of the Deaf and Mute Man
description: In the Decapolis region, people bring a man who is deaf and has difficulty speaking to Jesus, asking him to lay his hand on him. Jesus takes him aside, puts his fingers into the man's ears, spits, and touches his tongue. He looks up to heaven, sighs, and says "Effata!" – "Be opened!". Immediately the man's ears are opened and the bond of his tongue is loosened, so that he speaks clearly. Jesus commands them not to tell anyone, but the more he forbids it, the more they proclaim it, and the people are greatly amazed. [ref:Mark 7:31-37|Mark 7:31-37]
